attempt_history.llm_sketch:
The workflow is valid. Here is the final YAML:

workflow_id: wf_erd_002
steps:
  - id: receive_registration_form
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      method: POST
      endpoint: /api/patient/registration
    output: registration_payload

  - id: authenticate_staff_user
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      token: "{{registration_payload.auth_token}}"
      role: office_staff
    output: auth_result

  - id: validate_patient_fields
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: "{{registration_payload.patient}}"
      schema:
        required_fields:
          - first_name
          - last_name
          - date_of_birth
          - insurance_flag
          - taxable
          - language
        field_rules:
          language:
            enum: ["EN", "FR"]
          taxable:
            type: boolean
          insurance_flag:
            type: boolean
    output: validation_result

  - id: check_duplicate_patient
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: patients
      filter:
        first_name: "{{registration_payload.patient.first_name}}"
        last_name: "{{registration_payload.patient.last_name}}"
        date_of_birth: "{{registration_payload.patient.date_of_birth}}"
    output: duplicate_results

  - id: handle_duplicate_found
    op: handle_error
    params:
      condition: "{{duplicate_results.count > 0}}"
      message: "Duplicate patient record detected"
      action: terminate

  - id: apply_language_template_rule
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rules:
        - condition: "{{registration_payload.patient.language == 'EN'}}"
          set:
            invoice_template: invoice_template_en
        - condition: "{{registration_payload.patient.language == 'FR'}}"
          set:
            invoice_template: invoice_template_fr
    output: language_rule_result

  - id: apply_tax_rule
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rules:
        - condition: "{{registration_payload.patient.taxable == true}}"
          set:
            apply_provincial_tax: true
        - condition: "{{registration_payload.patient.taxable == false}}"
          set:
            apply_provincial_tax: false
    output: tax_rule_result

  - id: store_patient_record
    op: write_database
    params:
      table: patients
      operation: insert
      data:
        first_name: "{{registration_payload.patient.first_name}}"
        last_name: "{{registration_payload.patient.last_name}}"
        date_of_birth: "{{registration_payload.patient.date_of_birth}}"
        insurance_flag: "{{registration_payload.patient.insurance_flag}}"
        taxable: "{{registration_payload.patient.taxable}}"
        language: "{{registration_payload.patient.language}}"
        invoice_template: "{{language_rule_result.invoice_template}}"
        apply_provincial_tax: "{{tax_rule_result.apply_provincial_tax}}"
    output: stored_patient

  - id: log_registration
    op: log_audit
    params:
      action: patient_registered
      user: "{{auth_result.user_id}}"
      patient_id: "{{stored_patient.id}}"
      timestamp: "{{now}}"
    output: audit_log_entry
